description: GLS Regions is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation (GLS) Policy Headquarters. The Great Lakes St Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation (GLS) Regions dataset was compiled October 03, 2025 from the Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation (GLS) Policy Headquarters and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Great Lakes St. Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation (GLS) Policy Headquarters. Its keywords are boundaries, USA, National, NTAD, National Transportation Atlas Database, National, Transportation, Atlas. The bounding box given is -92.5185,40.1059,-74.6612,48.3061. The hub shows 2024-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
